render.prompt: Character design reference for a cozy retro top-down adventure game: a slim, tall little blue penguin (the small blue species) with a short feather tuft, a teal-blue back and a cream belly, gold goggles pushed up on its forehead, a leather tool belt, holding an oversized adjustable spanner. Full body, front view, standing upright facing the viewer, centered, chunky cute proportions with a big head. 16-bit pixel art style, clean flat colours, bold dark outline, simple readable shapes. Plain solid flat magenta background, no shadow, no text, no frame.
